diagnosis: Metastatic clear cell renal carcinoma in the adrenal gland
legend: Given the clear cytoplasm, the malignant cells are morphologically similar to zona fasciculata–type cells. The presence of cystic change is a clue, but immunohistochemistry would be required for a definitive diagnosis.

diagnosis: Metastatic clear cell renal carcinoma in the adrenal gland
legend: Diffuse strong nuclear expression of PAX8 in metastatic clear cell carcinoma in the adrenal gland allows ready distinction from zona glomerulosa–type adrenal cortical cells (PAX8 immunohistochemistry).

diagnosis: Metastatic colorectal carcinoma to the adrenal gland
legend: In this patient with known colorectal adenocarcinoma, the morphology of the metastatic deposit being composed of tall columnar cells with associated dirty necrosis allows definitive diagnosis without immunohistochemistry.

diagnosis: Metastatic lung carcinoma to the adrenal
legend: This example is from a 37-year-old woman with a history of lung carcinoma. The adrenal, 9 g, revealed a 12 mm homogeneous grey-white, firm, infiltrative lesion focally replacing the cortex and the medulla.
